tools.name: sleektech_list_properties
tools.description: List properties as a paged list with landlord, status, type, current tenant, monthly rent and arrears. Filter by landlord, status or parent property. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/properties/list.

tools.name: sleektech_list_tenancies
tools.description: List every tenancy across the portfolio (past, present and future) as a paged list. Filter by property, status or date range. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/tenancies/list.

tools.name: sleektech_get_property_tenancy
tools.description: Get the current tenancy for one property: dates, rent, status and deposit fields. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/tenancies/property/{propertyId}.

tools.name: sleektech_list_tenancy_people
tools.description: List the people on every tenancy in one paged call, with their contact details. Filter by property, tenancy ids or current tenancies only. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/tenancies/people.

tools.name: sleektech_list_landlords
tools.description: List landlords ordered by company name. Set view_all to include archived landlords. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/landlords.

tools.name: sleektech_list_suppliers
tools.description: List active suppliers with id, name and classification. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/suppliers.

tools.name: sleektech_list_staff
tools.description: List your active staff with id and name. Use these ids for assignedToId on notes. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/users/list.

tools.name: sleektech_list_maintenance_jobs
tools.description: List maintenance jobs across the portfolio as a paged list. Filter by property, landlord, status, open state or date range. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/maintenance/list.

tools.name: sleektech_get_maintenance_lookups
tools.description: List the values accepted by maintenance writes: 'categories' (with sub-categories), 'statuses' or 'priorities'. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/maintenance/{categories|statuses|priorities}.

tools.name: sleektech_save_maintenance_job
tools.description: Create a maintenance job for a property, or update it when external_id matches an existing job (upsert). Category and supplier are matched by name; an unmatched name creates a new record. Use sleektech_get_maintenance_lookups first. Nothing is deleted. SleekTech Open API: POST /v1/maintenance.

tools.name: sleektech_list_certificates
tools.description: List certificates across the portfolio as a paged list. Filter by expiry or issue date, property or certificate type. Use it to find certificates that expire soon. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/certificates/list.

tools.name: sleektech_get_property_certificates
tools.description: List the active certificates for one property: id, type code and description, and dates. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/certificates/property/{propertyId}.

tools.name: sleektech_list_certificate_types
tools.description: List the certificate types you can record against a property. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/certificates/types.

tools.name: sleektech_list_notes
tools.description: List notes, tasks and reminders, newest first. Filter by record, assignee, open state or due date. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/notes/list.

tools.name: sleektech_add_note
tools.description: Add a note, task or reminder to one record: a property, tenancy, landlord, job, supplier, certificate or expense. Give exactly one record id and the message. Set remind_at to email the assignee. SleekTech Open API: POST /v1/notes.

tools.name: sleektech_list_changes
tools.description: List the records created, updated or deleted since your last read. Each event names a type and an entity id; read that record again for its current state. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/events.

tools.name: sleektech_list_statements
tools.description: List owner statements across the portfolio as a paged list. Filter by landlord or date range. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/statements/list.

tools.name: sleektech_list_tenant_invoices
tools.description: List tenant invoices and credit notes (raw documents) as a paged list, for a date range. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/accounts/tenant-invoices.

tools.name: sleektech_list_tenant_payments
tools.description: List tenant payments and refunds as a paged list; each row is one payment applied to one invoice. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/accounts/tenant-payments.

tools.name: sleektech_list_supplier_invoices
tools.description: List supplier invoices and credit notes (raw documents) as a paged list, for a date range. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/accounts/supplier-invoices.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sleektech_save_maintenance_job, sleektech_list_certificates, sleektech_add_note · Private data: sleektech_list_tenancy_people, sleektech_save_maintenance_job, sleektech_list_certificate_types, sleektech_list_notes, sleektech_add_note, sleektech_list_changes, sleektech_list_tenant_invoices, sleektech_list_supplier_invoices · Public sink: sleektech_save_maintenance_job, sleektech_add_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sleektech_save_maintenance_job, sleektech_list_certificates, sleektech_add_note · Private data: sleektech_list_tenancy_people, sleektech_save_maintenance_job, sleektech_list_certificate_types, sleektech_list_notes, sleektech_add_note, sleektech_list_changes, sleektech_list_tenant_invoices, sleektech_list_supplier_invoices · Public sink: sleektech_save_maintenance_job, sleektech_add_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
